book.name: Honowok Nair
book.title: Roh Kudus Nin Honowok Nair Lolo Hophopon Ma Nodi Yesus Lirnenihe

content: Yesus nakinikan laa a'am raram
Konohiyala i makrom'u Teopilus, Lolo ainu'u horok dedesne ihin,
ya'u konohiyedi papa ha wo'ira man Yesus hi'i la wakuku nano lere dedesne An howok,

rakan lere alam Ai nakinikan laa a'am raram. Lere Ai kan ha'a laa a'am raram makun, Ai nodi Roh Kudus Nin molollo kuku kalla Nina hophopon man An niliyedi nonolu enihe leke hi rodi Lirna Wawa'an loikaru ri.

Enla An maki, maa mori wali'ur, la alam weli'akka raram Ai nalhari kemen idewe-idewe pakromo noro Nin ri enihe, leke hi rauroin kokkoo An mori wali'uredi me'e, la An wakuku hi hi'ihewi Makromod Lalap nodi molollo Nin ri mormori.
Lerida Ai noro hi maha ra'ak ne, An hopon hi, “Yon pelekleke mamhara Yerusalem, maa mamkene lolo koteni newek Ya Am'u nala Roh Kudus ki mi lernohi Nin nou man Ya'u konohiyedi mi lere man laedi me'e.
Nonolu eni Yohanis nodi oir ulutada mi, maa ka nalo'ol me'e Makromod Lalap nodi Roh Kudus ulutade mi.”
Ler namehin hi rore pakromo wali'ur ne, hi ra'ukanie, “Makrom'u, Num panaeku lere eni ma'akeperedi Romawi la ma'ariri noho Israel wali'ur leke mamwali Rai?”
Yesus walhe, “Makromod Lalap mehe Nin molollo nala alam la nala leken. Ai kan huri mi mauroin onne,

maa ka nalo'ol me'e, Makromod Lalap nala Roh Kudus naikoro mi honorok akin, de mim lernala Nin molollo mamwali Ainu'u man kuku maka lolo Yerusalem, lolo noho Yudea noro Samaria ne'en raram na'akeme, rakan noho pa'i'ik rai pakakar.”
Ai na'aheniyedi eni horu, hir po'onala Ai nakinikan laa lanik hehen nanumene noho ha'aha'a pupinedie.
Hi maha rahehe po'on Yesus ha'a laa lanik makun, ramlilinnohi mo'oni woro'o man nair nainair wawarhe ramririri kan ko'u hi.

Woro'ohe ra'ahenia, “Heih, ri Galilea mie! Alhi'ihepenia mamriri lolo eni po'opo'on lanik enie? Yesus eniyeni man idedi eni mim po'on nakinikan, laedi a'am raram me'e. Lere man mai An wali mai wali'ur naise idedi mim popo'on An ha'a laa a'am raram eni.”
Nili Matias Herre Yudas
Ler onne hir minle wo'or Au Zaitun de hir wali wali'ur laa Yerusalem. Wo'or onne lo'o kilu ida nano Yerusalem.
Hir rakanedi Yerusalem ne, laa nakar mene ha'a laa wawan laa kamar man hir miminle. Hi onnenihe:

content.text: Simon (ri ma namhene hair namehin nodi molollo hair Israel),

content: Akilere hi na'ahoru lawuku aki mahaku hi'i lir napanak roro idewe maeke ida woro'o. Yesus inne Maria aile haenhi roro wewerre Yesus mo'oniwalinhe.
Lerida Petrus namriri lolo walinhe toro (hi na'akeme lo'o ri rahu ida werro'o.) Enla ai na'ahenia,

“I wal'u na'ahoru! Nonolu eni Roh Kudus konohiyedi lolo Daud inhawa ma namwali noro Yudas na'ahenia ai onne namwali ma norkaru ri man kele Yesus wukue. Ha na'akeme ma aile Horok Lap eni peni namwali, de lere eniyeni Daud nin horok onne namwaliyedi me'e.
Nonolu eni Yudas onne namwali mahaku noro maika, la Yesus mehen nili ai leke lernohi maika kamwali Nin man lernohi pakunohi.”
Nano Yudas nin ailanne lere ai na'olu Yesus onneni, an lernala kupan rodi weli lari ipida. Lolo nin lari ip onne ai nediyawa la konoin napriki penia konoin romok maiyedi paharne idewe makiyedi.
Yudas nina makimaki eni pe'eredi ri manina Yerusalem na'akeme penia hi rodi rira wanakunu waki kirna onne naranne Akaldama, ma napa'ahne, ‘Lari Ip Rare’.
Petrus na'aheni wali'ur na'ahenia, “Panaeku eniyeni horokedi aile horok Mazmur me'e na'ahenia,

content.text: yon ri mahaku minle nakar onne.’

content: La horok aile haenhi ma na'ahenia,

content.text: ‘Enla na'amoli man panulu nala nin honowok ri namehin hi'ie.’

content: Ende lere eni wa'an rehi ika nili ri ida herre Yudas, leke namwali man kuku maka na'aheni Makromod Lalap na'amoriyedi Yesus wali'ur nano Nin makimaki. Wa'an rehi ik nili ri ma nadedem lernohi ika mamani lere Makromod Yesus noro ika min wewerre, nano lere Yohanis nodi oir ulutade ri rakan lere Yesus nakinikan laa a'am raram nano ika kalarna.”
Ende hir nili ri woro'o: Yusup Barsabas (rapolu Yustus haenhi) noro Matias.
Onne horu, hi na'akeme hi'i lir napanak ra'ahenia, “Makromod, O penia mauroin ri mormori akin, de kukul mayai nano ri woro'enihe inhoi Makromod nili,
leke herre Yudas howok honowok eni, ono Yudas eni hoikaruwedi honowok eniyeni la lernaledi nina hunukum me'e.”
Hir hi'i lir napanak horu ne, rala ri woro'enihe naran leke nili. Matias penia ma naran namhara. Ende kikan ai namwali man howok wewerre noro hophopon idaweli ida ma nodi Yesus Lirna enihe.

footnotes.text: Ri Yahudi rira holoor halauk kan huri ri nala'a ko'u rehi kilu ida Alam Renren Warwarna.
